issues.description: The problem text for task 'addGuestStudents' states the method should take a String parameter ("addGuestStudents(String)"), but the UML diagram and the provided solution implement and expect an int parameter ("addGuestStudents(int)"). This mismatch can lead students to implement the method with the wrong signature, causing compilation errors or failing tests if they follow the textual description instead of the UML/solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the parameter type consistent across artifacts. Update the problem statement text to specify addGuestStudents(int) to match the UML and solution (or alternatively change the UML and solution to use String if that was intended). Also update any example usages and the template comments to reflect the chosen parameter type (int) so students implement the correct signature.
